en: An old monochrome postcard showing a natural landscape with a rocky, eroded cliff or ravine, sparse trees on the slope above, and several people in dark clothing sitting or standing near the rock formations in the foreground. The lower margin contains German text identifying the location and publisher: "Wenden" and "Quelle bei ZihruI" with the publisher line "J. Kamien, Wenden."
